fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2006 fuel consumption, a 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel for the year ended December 31, 2006, would have increased fuel expense for the twelve month period by approximately $10.2 million. Fuel expense $101.6M at $2.12/gal avg.

instrument_type_details.notes: Jet fuel and heating oil option contracts or swap agreements; 10.2% of projected 2007 requirements hedged as of Dec 31, 2006; fair value ($1.3M); all contracts settle by end of May 2007

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense increased 93.2%, or $49.0 million, to $101.6 million in 2006 up from $52.6 million in 2005. This change was due to a 70.3% increase in gallons consumed and a 13.4% increase in the average cost per gallon to $2.12 per gallon during 2006 compared to $1.87 in 2005.
